title: Boas-vindas
purpose: Abrir o Bloco de Notas pela UI, digitar a mensagem de boas-vindas, ampliar a visualização e salvar Boas_Vindas.txt na Área de Trabalho do usuário.
end_state: An app opened only for this run is closed after a verified result, its saved tab first, so that Notepad does not bring it back at the next start; tabs of a restored session stay in the session; an app that was already open stays open; on any other result it stays open for checking.
collision: refuse: an existing Boas_Vindas.txt is never overwritten or renamed

verifier.text: Boas vindas à RedRise! Estamos felizes em tê-los conosco! Esperamos que as automações lhes seja útil!

notes: Zoom is a view setting of the editor; TXT files do not store it, so it is not verifiable from the file.
save_as: folder via the dialog's navigation field (Alt+D); only the file name in 'Nome do arquivo' (Alt+N). Derived inputs output_dir/output_name come from output_path.
